audit.whatIsWrong: tldr and report[0] claimed 'Nothing in your kit is a projectile he can wall'. Ice Shard (Q) is flagged a projectile in Lissandra's own kit, and Wind Wall blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds. Separately, several strings treated 'your Q' and 'Ice Shard' as two different abilities — they are the same spell — and whys[2] said the Wall 'blocks your CC', which it does not: Ring of Frost is a 450 self-centred root and Frozen Tomb is point-and-click at 550.
audit.why: Getting this backwards inverts the whole lane plan: the player is told to poke freely into the one ability that deletes the poke, and told to fear the wall on the two abilities it cannot touch.
audit.corrected: Ice Shard named as the single blockable spell; Ring of Frost and Frozen Tomb stated as immune; duplicate 'Q and Ice Shard' phrasing removed.
sources: enemyKit W text and blocksProjectiles flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side gave Lissandra all seven rows; content win[N] and the packet levelChart both read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Lissandra/Lissandra/Lissandra.
audit.why: Levels 1-5 are genuinely contested — Steel Tempest is a free 475-range poke on a flat 4s cooldown and Sweeping Blade is effectively 0.5s off his own wave, so he sets the terms until Frozen Tomb exists. From 6 the point-and-click stun is unanswerable by anything he owns, which is where the 57.11 win rate comes from.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 moved to Skill with rewritten whys; rows 4-6 already agreed and stayed Lissandra.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 phase why said nothing about why 6 is the flip.
audit.why: Frozen Tomb is 120/100/80s and point-and-click; Last Breath is 70/50/30s and requires an Airborne target. Self-R during the EQ3 whirlwind removes the airborne target his ultimate needs.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and dosFull[1].d now carry both cooldowns and the knockup dependency.

audit.whatIsWrong: lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT — breakdown.cooldowns had no number, despite the whole lane being a Wind Wall timing game.
audit.why: Wind Wall is 25s at rank 1 falling to 17s, standing for 4 seconds — a big enough gap that waiting it out is a plan.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall 25s/17s and 4s duration, Last Breath 70s/30s, Frozen Tomb 120s written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: lintFindings COPY_PASTE_BLEED on dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d; dosFull[2].t additionally asserted the false 'the shatter ignores his wall'.
audit.why: Both bodies were the trade strings under unrelated titles, and the Do's title told the player to poke into the wall.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to their titles; dosFull[2].t and .d rewritten around baiting the wall.

edits.before: The early game is a Windwall skill dance. Yasuo can block your Q and your Ice Shard with one well-timed Wall, so don't waste your key CC into it — poke with Q when it's down and remember his Wall has a long cooldown. Your E dash can't be blocked, so it's your tool to maintain pressure and bait the Wall out.
edits.after: The early game is a Wind Wall skill dance. Yasuo blocks Ice Shard with one well-timed Wall — it is the only projectile you own, so don't feed your poke into it; throw it on the downtime and remember 4 seconds of cover costs him 25. Your E dash can't be blocked, so it's your tool to keep pressure and bait the Wall out.

edits.after: Wind Wall your Ice Shard to deny the poke war

notes: Biggest fix: the tldr told the player nothing of theirs could be walled. Ice Shard is a projectile and Wind Wall blocks it for 4 seconds; Ring of Frost (450 self-centred root) and Frozen Tomb (550 point-and-click) are the abilities the wall cannot touch. Several strings also treated 'your Q' and 'Ice Shard' as two separate spells. Chart: full layer gave Lissandra all seven rows while content matched the packet; rows 0-3 moved to Skill with paired why rewrites, rows 4-6 already agreed. No win[N] edits were possible — the content layer already holds the correct values. Not asserted (kit silent): whether Wind Wall blocks the Frozen Thrall shatter, whether Ring of Frost's root is cleansable out of Last Breath's hold, and whether self-cast Frozen Tomb during the airborne window drops Last Breath already in flight — the self-R timing in dosFull[1].d is written as denying him the target, which the kit text supports. Yasuo is male; pronouns unchanged.
